meta.originalInput: Notice how lying on the couch scrolling doesn't recharge you when your mind is screaming with guilt? Physiologists call this Autonomic Nervous System Freeze. Pushing through exhaustion doesn't build mental toughness; it elevates baseline cortisol and conditions your body to live in survival mode, mistaking physical stillness for laziness. The solution is switching from passive numbing to active nervous system restoration: step away from all screens, take a slow fifteen-minute walk outdoors, or practice double-inhale physiological sighs. True biological recovery requires emotional safety, not just sitting still.
